note: Findings of the linter on stellar/wallet-backend that are accepted, one per entry, each with the reason it is accepted and the upstream issue that tracks it where one exists. scripts/check_accepted.py fails on any finding this file does not list. An entry matches a finding by rule, file and a substring of its message, not by line, so it survives unrelated edits. An entry that matches nothing is reported as resolved and should be removed. Accepting a finding records a triage decision; it does not mean the code is correct.

accepted.reason: Real, low severity: the walk of the declared authorization tree has no depth cap of its own. Reported first by the shapekit project as #820 (open, no maintainer reply on 16 November). A fix with a test is prepared on a local branch, awaiting issue acceptance.

accepted.message_contains: participants is filled from the transaction envelope
accepted.reason: A false positive for failed transactions, accepted as such. The finding is in GetOperationsParticipants (line 146), but the success check it asks for is one call down: since 9538b3ca (25 September 2026) GetOperationParticipants (lines 166-176 at the pin) returns only the source and the fee-bump account for a failed transaction. SC003 looks for the check in the function and its callers, not in the function it calls (linter/README.md, Known false positives). For a successful transaction the participants come from the operation body, which is what the rule describes; the meta shows those accounts changed.

accepted.message_contains: operationsParticipants is filled from the transaction envelope
accepted.reason: Same site and same reason as the entry above: the same participants written into the per-operation map (line 155).

accepted.message_contains: memo text is read with GetText()
accepted.reason: Real, not reachable today: utils.Memo returns memo text without a UTF-8 check, but nothing calls it and no table stores memo text. #800 (open, by a maintainer) plans a memo column; once a memo is stored, the check matters, because stellar-core accepts any 28 bytes and PostgreSQL TEXT rejects invalid UTF-8 and NUL.
